No readable text or glyphs ANYWHERE, no brand names/logos/badges, no number plate text, no signs with lettering, no watermark, no UI, no borders. No people in focus. Opaque full-scene image.
Scene: A yellow 6x6 recovery truck extracting a mud-caked green 6x6 off-road cargo truck from a cypress swamp. Each vehicle has exactly three axles, one front and a close rear tandem, six tires total. Yellow recovery truck in the foreground right driving toward right on a muddy causeway; green truck behind it toward centre-left in the shallow bog, both within central 60%. All vehicles combined, including every bumper and load, must fit between pixel x=330 and x=1200 on the 1536-wide canvas. Do NOT fill the frame with vehicles. Reserve the outer 20% on each side entirely for landscape. Vehicle ground contacts approximately y=750; bottom 205 pixels are calm unoccupied shaded foreground. Truck group around 850 pixels wide maximum.
